description: This file implements the logic for handling custom actions in the Cuttlefish Android emulator, including parsing JSON configurations, serializing configurations, and managing custom action instances and their associated data structures.

classes.name: CustomActionConfigImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the CustomActionConfigProvider interface, managing custom action configurations, parsing JSON, serialization, and flag processing.

methods.name: GetCustomActionInstanceIDFromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON object to extract a CustomActionInstanceID.

methods.name: GetCustomShellActionConfigFromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON object to create a CustomShellActionConfig.

methods.name: GetCustomActionServerConfigFromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON object to create a CustomActionServerConfig.

methods.name: GetCustomDeviceStateActionConfigFromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON object to create a CustomDeviceStateActionConfig.

methods.name: ToJson
methods.description: Serializes various custom action configuration objects into JSON.

methods.name: DefaultCustomActionConfig
methods.description: Returns the default path for custom action configuration JSON file.

methods.name: get_instance_order
methods.description: Returns the index of an instance based on its ID string.
